summary: Confirmed $65.40/night (30 or 50 A, two people; now manual, 2026) with a stated 10% Good Sam/AAA/AARP rate ($58.86), so good_sam true; full hookups 30/50 A at all sites, 129 sites mostly pull-through, showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, guest-only dump; reservations by phone recommended. Cleared the derived 85-ft maximum (not on the operator's pages). Note: the 'paved concrete pads' claim is contradicted (operator: 'level and grassy sites') and field facts dropped. Over US$50 but 35 km from Congaree NP (gateways.py), so the gateway exception applies; not stayed at. Weekly/monthly rates sit beside a posted nightly rate (not a long-stay park). Season not stated.
